title: Isolation of Single Nuclei from Solid Tissues
author: Blue Lake
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ufketkw
materials: Treat dounce with RNAseZap, rinse with sterile water (if possible: UV treat 00:15:00 ) RNase Zap Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #R2020-250ML
For sections stored in a stabilizing solution (e.g. RNAlater), wash briefly with PBS and immediately proceed to Step 5 below RNAlater Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM7020
Bring up to 10 mL with PBSE
QA/QC: Count nuclei (e.g. BioRad T20 Cell Counter) (Bio-Rad, 1450011, Cell Counting Slides for TC10™/TC20™ Cell Counter, Dual-Chamber)

steps.title: Prepare NEB-complete buffer
steps.instruction: Make NEB buffer on ice containing 5 µg/mL DAPI (Invitrogen Cat #D3571) and 0.04 U/µL RNase Inhibitor (Enzymatics Cat #Y9240L); for chromatin accessibility assays add cOmplete™ Protease Inhibitor Cocktail at 1:100 dilution (stock: one tablet dissolved in 0.5 mL H₂O, Roche Cat #11836153001).

steps.title: Place tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Transfer the vial containing solid tissue (e.g., adult human kidney) to ice; if using 40 µm cryosections, select the number of sections based on desired yield and tissue size—approximately 6 mm³ of kidney yields 150–200 K nuclei.

steps.title: Add cold NEB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL ice‑cold NEB‑complete buffer to the tissue segments.

steps.title: Enlarge pipette tip and disperse
steps.instruction: Using a sterile scalpel, cut off the end of a p1000 tip to widen the bore; pipette the tissue up and down ~20 times to disperse and dissolve OCT.

steps.title: Further dissociate with regular tip
steps.instruction: With a regular p1000 tip, pipette the suspension ~10 times to break tissue into manageable pieces (tissue must pass easily through the tip); then transfer the suspension to a dounce homogenizer.

steps.title: Dounce homogenization on ice
steps.instruction: On ice, dounce the suspension: 5 strokes with pestle A, then ~20 strokes with pestle B while minimizing bubble formation; increase pestle A strokes if tissue remains granular; adjust pestle B strokes according to tissue toughness (soft: 10–15 strokes; hard: 15–20 strokes).

steps.title: Collect homogenate
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenate to a 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Wash dounce and combine
steps.instruction: Wash the dounce homogenizer with 1 mL NEB‑complete buffer and add this wash to the same 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Pass the supernatant through a 30 µm CellTrics filter (Sysmex Cat #04‑004‑2324) into a new 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 900 g for 10 minutes at 4 °C to pellet nuclei.

steps.title: Decide downstream use
steps.instruction: If nuclei will be used immediately for single‑nucleus assays, proceed to downstream assay preparation; if nuclei are to be stored, continue to the next step.

steps.title: Resuspend nuclei
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 100 µL–1000 µL PBS containing 0.1 % RNase Inhibitor (volume chosen based on downstream assay and desired nuclei concentration); 1 % BSA may be added optionally.

steps.title: Add RNAlater and store
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL RNAlater (Thermo Fisher Cat #AM7020) to 100 µL of the nuclei suspension, incubate at 4 °C for 1–2 hours, then transfer to –20 °C for 1–2 months.

steps.title: Quality control microscopy
steps.instruction: Examine nuclei under a fluorescent microscope using the DAPI channel; nuclei should be distinct, rounded, and mostly singlets. If clumping is high, re‑filter through a 30‑µm CellTrics filter or discard. Minimum counts: ≥50,000 nuclei for snDrop‑seq, ≥10,000 for 10X 3’ RNA v3.

steps.title: Remove RNAlater before assay
steps.instruction: Centrifuge nuclei at 4000 g for 10 minutes at 4 °C, discard RNAlater, and resuspend nuclei in the assay‑specific resuspension buffer.
